load_menu.name: Load Menu
load_menu.help: Replace the current menu. Menus from store are made outside the script and run their own code

builtin.name: %s (built-in)
builtin.help: The menu that ships with the script
builtin.copied_help:
Copied from pack '%s'.
Remove from core: deletes exactly the copied files, unloading the menu first if it's loaded.
builtin.auto_copy_again: Copying to core is on: the menu comes back at the next start

pack.help:
v%s by %s
Runs its own code with full access: load only packs you trust
pack.options_help: Copy to core: becomes the built-in menu and runs at every start

profile.title: Profiles
profile.help: Script profiles: the script's own settings (names, command prefix). Stand's own profiles still keep item states.

create.name: Create Profile
create.help: Saves the current values as a new profile and loads it. Name: a-z, 0-9, _ and -

create_main.name: Create Main Profile
create_main.help: Makes the main profile with the defaults; when it's there, makes it again after a warning
create_main.warning: The %s profile is already there. Make it again with the defaults? Its settings will be lost
create_main.recreated: Profile %s made again with the defaults

open_folder.name: Open Folder
open_folder.help: Opens the folder with the profile files

entry.help: * means the active profile has unsaved changes

save.name: Save
save.help: Writes the current values into this profile
save.overwrite: Overwrite profile '%s' with the values of '%s'?

load.name: Load
load.help: Makes this profile active and applies its values
load.unsaved: Profile '%s' has unsaved changes. Load anyway and lose them?

autosave.name: Automatically Save
autosave.help: Every change of this profile's values is saved right away

reset.name: Reset To Defaults
reset.help: Puts every value of this profile back to the script's defaults. Click twice within 5 seconds
reset.warning:
Reset every value of profile '%s' to the defaults?
Click again within %d seconds to reset
reset.done: Profile '%s' is back to the defaults

delete.name: Delete
delete.help: Deletes this profile, main and the last one too; deleting the active one loads another, with none left the script goes on with its values

settings.name: Settings
settings.help: Values of the active profile and the script itself

display_name.name: Display Name
display_name.help: Name shown in the menu, e.g. the settings section

short_name.name: Short Name
short_name.help: Short name, e.g. for log and notification lines

command_box_prefix.name: Base Commands Prefix
command_box_prefix.help: Prefix of the script's own commands (Base Commands); empty for none. Commands are renamed right away

separator.name: Base Commands Separator: %s
separator.help: Between the prefix and the name of the script's own commands

command_box_found_prefix.name: Found Commands Prefix
command_box_found_prefix.help: Prefix of the loaded menu's commands (Found Commands); empty for none. Commands are renamed right away

found_separator.name: Found Commands Separator: %s
found_separator.help: Between the prefix and the name of the loaded menu's commands. A different prefix or separator than the base commands' keeps the same names apart

command_box_user_prefix.name: Prefix
command_box_user_prefix.help: Prefix of your own commands; empty for none. Commands are renamed right away

user_separator.name: Separator: %s
user_separator.help: Between the prefix and the name of your own commands

log_name.name: Name In Logs: %s
log_name.help: Which name log and notification lines start with

notify.name: Notifications
notify.help: Where the script's notifications, warnings and errors show and how they look

flash.name: Flash Notifications
flash.help: Notifications in the game's feed flash when they show, in the flash color for the time of day. Stand's notifications don't flash

target.name: Type: %s
target.help: Stand: Stand's notifications. Game: the game's notification feed, styled as set under Game. No Notifications: nothing on screen, only Stand's log

emoticons.name: Emoticons
emoticons.help: An emoticon at the end of a notification, by its kind

on.name: Emoticons In Notifications
on.help: Adds the emoticon of its kind at the end of each notification; the log stays as it is

errors.name: Errors Always In Stand
errors.help: Errors show in Stand's notifications whatever is chosen above, so none goes unseen

examples.name: Notification Examples
examples.help: How each kind of notification looks now, where notifications show
examples.one_help: Shows an example of this kind; the examples are taken away from the game's feed on going back out of Notifications

info.name: Notification
info.text: This is how a notification looks

warn.name: Warning
warn.text: This is how a warning looks

error.name: Error
error.text: This is how an error looks

success.name: Success
success.text: This is how a success looks

all.name: All At Once
all.help: Shows an example of every kind

newline.name: Text On A New Line
newline.help: Stand's notifications show the text on a line of its own, under [AnitaDarin | ... ]

style.name: Notification Type: %s
style.help: Message: a card with a picture, the script's name, the notification type and the text. Post: one line, as in the log

picture.name: Picture: %s
picture.help: The picture on the script's message cards. Shown only while Notification Type is Message

icon.name: Icon: %s
icon.help: The small icon at the top right of the script's message cards. Shown only while Notification Type is Message

day_start.name: Day Starts At
day_start.help: The hour by the game's clock from which the day colors are used

night_start.name: Night Starts At
night_start.help: The hour by the game's clock from which the night colors are used, until the day starts

background_day.name: Day Background Color
background_day.help: The background of the script's notifications in the game's feed during the day

flash_color_day.name: Day Flash Color
flash_color_day.help: The color notifications flash in during the day when Flash Notifications is on

subject_color_day.name: Day Subject Color: %s
subject_color_day.help: The color of the notification type (Information, Warning, Error) on message cards during the day. By Type: information blue, warnings yellow, errors red. Shown only while Notification Type is Message

background_night.name: Night Background Color
background_night.help: The background of the script's notifications in the game's feed at night

flash_color_night.name: Night Flash Color
flash_color_night.help: The color notifications flash in at night when Flash Notifications is on

subject_color_night.name: Night Subject Color: %s
subject_color_night.help: The color of the notification type (Information, Warning, Error) on message cards at night. By Type: information blue, warnings yellow, errors red. Shown only while Notification Type is Message

debug.name: Debug Mode
debug.help: Show debug-level log lines in the Stand console and notifications

load_timing.name: Load Timing
load_timing.help: Writes each script file's load time to Stand's log as it loads, and a full report at every start. Works without Debug Mode
load_timing.on: Load times go to Stand's log: each file as it loads, and a full report at the next start
load_timing.done: Load times are in Stand's log

reload_natives.name: Reload Natives
reload_natives.help: Reads the native files (lib/AnitaDarin/natives) from disk again: changes to them work without restarting the script
reload_natives.done: Natives reloaded, files: %d. They load again on first use

log_keep_days.name: Keep Logs (Days)
log_keep_days.help: How many days of the script's log files (store/<script>/logs, a file per day) are kept, today included. Older files are removed at the start and when a new day begins. 0 keeps them all

log_info_at_once.name: Write Info At Once
log_info_at_once.help: Every log line goes to the file at once, not within a second. Warnings and errors always go at once. Slower, but nothing is lost if the game crashes

auto_copy.name: Copy Menu To Core: %s
auto_copy.help: At every start this menu from store is copied into the script and loaded as its built-in menu, so Stand's profile restores the states of its items (a menu loaded by hand doesn't get them). Takes effect at the next start; save the profile to keep it
auto_copy.later: '%s' will be copied to core at the next start
auto_copy.disabled: Copying to core is off; the copy in core stays

rename.name: Rename Script
rename.help: Renames the script's file and its lib/store/resources folders, then restarts it under the new name. Letters, digits and _ only
rename.warning:
Rename the script '%s' to '%s'?
Its file and folders will be renamed and it will restart.
Stand profile states saved under the old name won't apply to the new one.
rename.invalid: '%s' isn't a valid name: use letters, digits and _
rename.busy: Not renamed: an open folder is keeping the script from being renamed (%s). Close Explorer windows, editors and consoles open inside it and try again
rename.done: Renamed to %s. If it doesn't start by itself, start %s in Stand > Lua Scripts

language.list_help: The script's language, and translations into others
language.name: Language: %s
language.help: Language of the script. Auto follows Stand's language
language.auto_help: Show the script in Stand's language
language.unavailable: Stand is in English, so the script can't be shown in another language: it follows Stand. The choice is kept and works while Stand is in another language

create.name: Create Translation
create.help: Starts a translation into a new language: a file to translate in each folder of strings, a copy of the language picked

code.name: Language Code
code.help: The new language's code, a language and its country: de-de, fr-fr, pt-br

language_name.name: Language Name
language_name.help: How the language shows in the language list, in itself: Deutsch, Français

from.name: Translate From: %s
from.help: Which language's text the new files start with

create_button.name: Create
create_button.help: Makes the files; ones there already stay as they are

show_keys.name: Show Keys
show_keys.help: Shows each string's key instead of its text, to see which key is which while translating
show_keys.unavailable: Stand is in English, so the keys can't be shown: the script follows Stand's texts. Works while Stand is in another language

progress.name: Translation Progress
progress.help: How much of each translation is done; the strings left go to Stand's log, key by key. A string the same as the English one counts as not translated
progress.none: There are no translations yet: Create Translation starts one

translation.created: Translation %s created, files: %d. Translate them in the folder, then Reload Translations
translation.bad_code: '%s' isn't a language code: write it like de-de

reload.name: Reload Translations
reload.help: Reads the language files again: changes show without restarting the script

notify_emoticon_info.name: Notification
notify_emoticon_info.help: The emoticon of a notification; empty - none

notify_emoticon_warn.name: Warning
notify_emoticon_warn.help: The emoticon of a warning; empty - none

notify_emoticon_error.name: Error
notify_emoticon_error.help: The emoticon of an error; empty - none

notify_emoticon_success.name: Success
notify_emoticon_success.help: The emoticon of a success (copied, saved...); empty - none

profile.no_profiles: No profiles: Create Main Profile or Save brings one back

modules.title: Modules
modules.help: The script's internal modules. Shown in debug mode only

open_folder.name: Open Folder
open_folder.help: Opens the modules folder in Lua Scripts. Reload reads the files from there

stop_all.name: Stop All
stop_all.help: Stops every module and every loop started by hand

reload_changed.name: Reload Changed
reload_changed.help: Reloads the modules whose files changed since they were loaded (marked "file changed")

reload_all.name: Reload All
reload_all.help: Reloads every module loaded from a file, even if the file didn't change, and starts it

modules.base_functions_help: on_start, on_tick, on_stop: the hooks the module manager calls

no_categories.name: Disable Function Categories
no_categories.help: The module's functions in one list, without Getters, Setters and the others; the base functions as a section, not a list

modules.variables_help: The module's fields and their values, kept up to date while the list is open

edit.help: The new value as an expression: 5, true, "text", v3.new(1, 2, 3), nil. Written to the table at once

call.help: Arguments separated by commas, as in Lua: 5, true, "text", v3.new(1, 2, 3), entities.get_user_vehicle_as_handle(). A word without quotes is text. Worked out at each call. — in the help: not given
call.button_help: Calls the function once; what it gives shows in a notification and on the Variable line
call.hook_help: Calls the module's hook; its status doesn't change

guide.name: Arguments Guide
guide.help: Sends to Stand how to write the functions' arguments in the Arguments field

loop.help: Calls the function: now, after a while, when its list is opened or hovered, in a loop
loop.call_on_enter_help: Calls the function as soon as the Arguments are typed in
loop.call_after_help: Calls the function once after so many milliseconds
loop.call_on_open_help: Calls the function every time its list is opened
loop.call_on_focus_help: Calls the function every time the cursor comes onto its list
loop.loop_help: Calls the function every frame while it's on
loop.every_help: Calls the function once every so many milliseconds; switches Loop on, which also switches it off
loop.call_in_tables_help: The functions in the Value list become lists with the same menu as Call Function, except the name and the notice in Stand
loop.edit_in_tables_help: The values in the Value list (not functions or tables) become fields: type a new expression (5, true, "text", v3.new(1, 2, 3), nil) and it's written to the table
loop.table_depth_help: How many levels of nested tables open in the Value list; deeper ones are a {...} line. A big depth on big tables makes a great many items

tick.help: Runs on_tick by hand every frame; the time it takes shows on screen. A running module is stopped first
tick.start_init_help: on_start, then on_tick every frame until stopped; on_stop at the end
tick.start_help: Only on_tick every frame until stopped, without on_start and on_stop
tick.start_for_help: Only on_tick every frame for the seconds picked
tick.stop_help: Stops the loop started by hand; after Start With Init calls on_stop
tick.module_stopped: %s stopped: the loop runs by hand

unload.name: Unload
unload.help: Takes the loaded menu out of the script; Load Menu brings one back

command_box.name: Command Box
command_box.help: Command names of the script's items

base_commands.name: Base Commands
base_commands.help: The script's own commands, without the prefix. Each opens a list where it can be renamed and given extra words; kept in store/AnitaDarin/commands

found_commands.name: Found Commands
found_commands.help: The loaded menu's commands, without the prefix. Each opens a list where it can be renamed and given extra words; kept in the menu's commands folder (the pack's in store, or core)
found_commands.none: No menu is loaded or it has no commands

focus.name: Go To Item
focus.help: Takes the cursor to this command's item in the menu
focus.failed: Can't go to the item: it may be hidden now

rename.name: Custom Name
rename.help: A name of your own for this command; the prefix stays. Empty: its own name
rename.taken: '%s' is already a command of another item
rename.failed: '%s' can't be used as a command name

reset.name: Reset Name
reset.help: Gives the command back its own name

add.name: Add Word
add.help: One more command for this item, with the same prefix; it can have several

words.remove_help: Click to take this word off

found_commands.not_saved: The custom command names couldn't be saved

user_commands.name: User Commands
user_commands.help: Your own commands: a name that runs other commands, Stand's or the script's, one after another

create.name: Create
create.help: Type the new command's name: it shows below, then write what it runs in its Commands

remove.name: Remove
remove.help: Removes the command picked, with its file

run.name: Run
run.help: Runs the commands written in Commands

commands.name: Commands
commands.help: What it runs: Stand's or the script's commands separated by ; - godmode on; tpwaypoint

description.name: Description
description.help: Shown as the help of Run and of the command

user_commands.none: No commands yet: Create one above
user_commands.created: Command %s created: write what it runs in its Commands
user_commands.invalid: '%s' has nothing usable for a command name (a-z, 0-9, _)
user_commands.nothing: %s runs nothing yet: write its Commands
user_commands.loop: %s runs itself over and over: stopped
user_commands.example: Example: opens the script's settings. Its Commands show how: a command of Stand or the script, more separated by ;

commands_folder.name: Open Commands Folder
commands_folder.script_help: Opens the folder with the script's commands' custom names and words: store/AnitaDarin/commands
commands_folder.menu_help: Opens the loaded menu's commands folder: its commands' custom names and words
commands_folder.no_menu: No menu is loaded: there's no commands folder

open_folder.name: Open Folder
open_folder.help: The script's folders in Stand's Lua Scripts

lib.name: Open Lib Folder
lib.help: The script's code: lib/AnitaDarin in Stand's Lua Scripts

resources.name: Open Resource Folder
resources.help: The script's resources (images, sounds): resources/AnitaDarin. Made if it doesn't exist yet

store.name: Open Store Folder
store.help: The script's data: profiles, settings, menus and translations, store/AnitaDarin

logs.name: Open Log Folder
logs.help: The script's log files, one per day: store/AnitaDarin/logs. Made if it doesn't exist yet

debug.name: Debug
debug.help: Debug mode, the script's modules and the script itself

script_menu.logs_help: The script's log: the name in its lines, how long the files are kept, when they are written, clearing them

settings.name: Settings
settings.help: The script's own settings, whichever menu is loaded

languages.name: Languages
languages.help: What helps with translating the script

clear_log.name: Clear Current Log File
clear_log.help: Removes today's log file only; the other days stay. The next line starts it again
clear_log.none: There's no log file for today yet

clear_logs.name: Clear All Log Files
clear_logs.help: Removes every log file of the script. Opens a confirmation first
clear_logs.warning:
Remove every log file of the script in %s?
This can't be undone.

call_function.name: Call Function
call_function.help: Calls any function of the script by name, with arguments

function.name: Function Name
function.help: A path from Atdar with dots: game.repair_vehicle. The first part may be a module's name: VehicleManager.get. With a colon the function is called as a method: VehicleManager:get

args.name: Argument
args.help: Arguments separated by commas, as in Lua: 5, true, "text", v3.new(1, 2, 3). A word without quotes is text

on_enter_name.name: Call After Typing Function
on_enter_name.help: Calls the function as soon as its name is typed in, with the arguments already typed. A table or a variable is read when its name is typed

on_enter.name: Call After Typing Arguments
on_enter.help: Calls the function as soon as the arguments are typed in

stand.name: Notice In Stand
stand.help: The result comes as a Stand notification, not in the game's feed

call.name: Call
call.help: Calls a function once, reads a table or a variable; the result is in the notice, in the Variable line and, for a table, in the Value list

depth.name: Table Depth
depth.help: How many levels of nested tables open in the Value list; deeper ones are a {...} line. A big depth on big tables (Atdar) makes a great many items

delete_script.name: Delete Script
delete_script.help: Deletes the script from Stand's Lua Scripts. Opens a list with the confirm button
delete_script.warning:
Delete the script '%s' with all its files, profiles and settings too (launcher, lib, store and resources folders)?
This can't be undone.
delete_script.done: Script '%s' deleted (%d file(s)). It stops now

keep.name: Keep Profiles And Settings
keep.help: Keeps store/<name>/profiles and config.json, so a reinstall finds them

confirm.name: Delete Script For Good
confirm.help: Click twice within 5 seconds: deletes the launcher and the lib, store and resources folders, then stops the script
confirm.again_notice: Click it again within %d seconds to delete

delete_script.warning_keep:
Delete the script '%s' (launcher, lib, store and resources folders)? Profiles and settings are kept.
This can't be undone.

clear_feed.name: Remove Game Notifications
clear_feed.help: Takes every notification of the script out of the game's feed; the game's and other scripts' stay
clear_feed.done: Notifications taken out of the feed: %d
clear_feed.none: No notifications of the script in the feed

updater_menu.name: Update
updater_menu.help: Checking for and installing a new version of the script

check.name: Check For Updates
check.help: Finds out whether a new version of the script is out

install.name: Update
install.help: Downloads and installs the new version; profiles and settings stay

auto.name: Update Automatically
auto.help: Installs a new version by itself as soon as a check finds one

check_days.name: Check For Updates Every (Days)
check_days.help: How often to check whether a new version is out. Applied on a click; 0 - never
check_days.set: Updates will be checked every %d days

branch.name: Update Branch: %s
branch.help: Where updates come from: main - tried versions, experiment - the newest, less tried
branch.set: Updates will come from the %s branch
